findings.text: the landing record establishes, with exact independently-reproduced values, that all three named topology tests are still red at the merge and were already red at the main parent, but neither the plan text nor the followups section names a tracked remediation item for actually fixing them; a reader of the section sees a closed attribution question and an open correctness question with no pointer between the two. This is a completeness gap in the downstream linkage rather than a defect in the attribution itself, since the node's declared scope was strictly to attribute, not to repair or to open a followup.

justifications.durability: the record is permanently retained: report.md, both TSV matrices, all five gate logs (two rejected, three authoritative) and both forward.py diffs sit under the fixed report path and are cited by absolute path from the landed evidence anchor, and scratch-cleanup.log proves the scratch trees were removed. Docked because, as a one-off forensic attribution rather than a guarded behavior, nothing in this node creates a regression test or a tracked followup that would surface if the three tests' pre-existing red status were later mistaken for a new regression; the next investigator has to re-read this section rather than being pointed to it by an open item.
justifications.evidence: independently verified every load-bearing number in the report against the raw logs rather than trusting the prose: reran no new tests but cross-read gate-complete-<revision>.log for all three revisions and found the raster coordinates ((2.34,-9.238287e-15) at main/merge, (2.34,-8.621085e-15) at worker tip, both against desired (2.34,-1.345008e-14)), the MAST saddle ((0.589257,1.216816) at all three against desired (0.591752,1.219749)), and the value-bytes assertion (equal at main/merge, differing -- i.e. passing -- at the worker tip) match the report and the landed HTML verbatim. Also independently diffed the raw (rejected) gate-8df973b70... log against gate-complete-8df973b70...: the rejected run genuinely raised FileNotFoundError on the MAST fixture and the complete rerun genuinely executed the assertion, confirming the report's own disclosure that the first matrix was invalid rather than merely asserting it. Independently parsed both forward.py diffs by def-block: the main-parent diff's 128 changed lines fall only inside _clip_consistent_seed, and the worker-parent diff's 4 changed lines fall only inside _secondary_x_point and match the quoted snippet exactly.
justifications.fit: no source, test or fixture file was touched; the investigation ran entirely through git-archived scratch trees in one all_debug allocation (satisfying the one-measurement-one-SLURM-job rule), one fresh CPU process per revision, and the scratch root was removed afterward with a receipt proving it. The rejected first matrix was kept on disk rather than silently discarded, which is the right instinct for an investigation whose own instrument turned out to be flawed. No figure was added, correctly, since the deliverable is a revision matrix and a code diff, both naturally tabular/textual.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the done-when's four discrete requirements are all met and independently verified: a report recording pass/fail for all three named tests at all three named revisions with each log on disk; a diff of forward.py against both parents naming every hunk outside the exact-mode seed branch (128 lines confined to _clip_consistent_seed relative to main, 4 lines confined to _secondary_x_point relative to the worker); a verdict drawn from exactly the closed set the fence specifies (pre-existing, correctly selected since all three tests already fail at the merge's main parent f3b52e8e1^1); and confirmation that no checkout was modified and scratch was removed. The verdict is stated with the specific quantitative evidence that makes it checkable rather than asserted.
justifications.scope_discipline: changed_paths (docs/plans/exact-clip-moment-quadrature.html, docs/evidence/archive/exact-clip-moment-quadrature-landed.html) and the crew/reports write path are exactly the declared fence, one commit, no plan-version/plan-modified meta lines touched. The worker correctly left section/followup closure to the coordinator ('coordinator review and integration remain') rather than resolving anything itself. Docked one point for the completeness gap named in findings: the pre-existing red status of three tests is documented but not linked forward into an actionable item, which sits just outside this node's declared scope but is the kind of loose end a reviewer is asked to surface.
